title: DesertX Rally Edition
description: The Ducati DesertX Rally Edition delivers all-weather long-haul versatility with long-travel suspension compliance for riders demanding purposeful real-world performance. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against its responsive chassis architecture, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. Focused on closed-course control and sporting precision, its Aggressive Forward Tuck posture pairs with a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines to optimize high-speed aerodynamic stability.
